family.description: This family, also known in yeasts as Rmd11, complexes with NPR2, [pfam:PF06218]. This complex heterodimer is responsible for inactivating TORC1. an evolutionarily conserved protein complex that controls cell size via nutritional input signals, specifically, in response to amino acid starvation.
family.name: Nitrogen Permease regulator of amino acid transport activity 3
